name: Yahari Game demo Ore no Seishun Love Come wa Machigatteiru. Kan
original_name: やはりゲームでも俺の青春ラブコメはまちがっている。完
source:
As the scenarios diverge from the TV anime "Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Come wa Machigatteiru. Kan", six different stories will be told depending on the player's choices!
The destination of the story of the hero, Hachiman, and the heroines is left to you, the ...... player!
[from [url=https://store-jp.nintendo.com/list/software/70010000061561.html]Nintendo Store[/url]]
translation:
本作剧情自电视动画《我的青春恋爱物语果然有问题。完》分歧展开，根据玩家的选择，将讲述六段截然不同的故事！
主人公八幡与女主角们的故事将走向何方，全都交由身为玩家的你……来决定！
[引自[url=https://store-jp.nintendo.com/list/software/70010000061561.html]Nintendo Store[/url]]
